problems: All 16 dossiers are new states with no Cliopatria row; the brief gave me no rows, so there are no cliopatria_names to report and nothing to split or merge.

Vassal/suzerain events are owed to other dossiers: principality-of-achaea (marquisate-of-bodonitsa 1248, lordship-of-salona c.1212, lordship-of-argos-and-nauplia), catalan-company (bodonitsa 1311, salona), duchy-of-athens (salona), the Ottoman dossier (gattilusi, acciaioli-duchy-of-athens from early 1394, despotate-of-the-morea from 1446, maona-of-chios), and the Tulunid/Abbasid/Hamdanid dossiers (emirate-of-tarsus).

Resolve warnings: Sutri (exarchate-of-ravenna) and Rethymno (kingdom-of-candia) are not in the gazetteer, so those regions will not draw until added or replaced by lon-lat circles; acciaioli-duchy-of-athens uses the counterpart 'navarrese-company', which has no dossier yet.

Type choices are judgment calls: colony (drawn as a tint of the metropole) for exarchate-of-ravenna, despotate-of-the-morea, kingdom-of-candia, maona-of-chios, catepanate-of-italy, spania, venetian-modon-and-coron; state for the rest. sclaviniae-of-greece is tribal land, not a state ('state' is a placeholder; a neutral 'nobody' tint may suit).

Overlaps: spania and exarchate-of-africa (af-02-x) both touch the Balearics (spania leaves them out); kingdom-of-candia and venetian-modon-and-coron may duplicate an eu-13-x Venetian overseas holdings dossier (checked at write time: none existed); sclaviniae-of-greece overlaps eu-06-x's Slavic settlement scope only in Greece.
Four fetches failed: Alexios_Kallergis and Theme_of_Longobardia (404), Methoni,_Greece (not found), Methoni (disambiguation, replaced by Methoni,_Messenia).

Region extents are upper bounds (radius circles) wherever the pages give none: gattilusi, hospitaller-rhodes Dodecanese, lordship-of-argos-and-nauplia, marquisate-of-bodonitsa, lordship-of-salona, emirate-of-tarsus and the Slavic lands; ledger events that bridge page silence are confidence 1 (13 in all).

Page budget: despotate-of-the-morea used 8 pages, exarchate-of-ravenna 5, hospitaller-rhodes 5; the three Frankish-Greece lordships (argos, bodonitsa, salona) used one page each. No rows of Cliopatria were touched and no file outside the brief's list was changed.
